Symbol.Name: Table_Parametrique
Symbol.Script_1D:
! ===== SCRIPT MAITRE ===== IF hauteurTable < 0.30 THEN hauteurTable = 0.30 IF epPlateau < 0.01 THEN epPlateau = 0.01 IF epPlateau > hauteurTable / 2 THEN epPlateau = hauteurTable / 2 IF largPied < 0.02 THEN largPied = 0.02 IF retraitPied < 0 THEN retraitPied = 0 IF retraitPied > A / 2 - largPied THEN retraitPied = MAX(0, A / 2 - largPied) IF retraitPied > B / 2 - largPied THEN retraitPied = MAX(0, B / 2 - largPied)
hPieds = hauteurTable - epPlateau
DIM px[4], py[4] px[1] = retraitPied : py[1] = retraitPied px[2] = A - retraitPied - largPied : py[2] = retraitPied px[3] = retraitPied : py[3] = B - retraitPied - largPied px[4] = A - retraitPied - largPied : py[4] = B - retraitPied - largPied
Symbol.Script_3D:
! ===== SCRIPT 3D ===== PEN stylo
MATERIAL matPieds FOR i = 1 TO 4 ADD px[i], py[i], 0 BLOCK largPied, largPied, hPieds DEL 1 NEXT i
MATERIAL matPlateau ADD 0, 0, hPieds BLOCK A, B, epPlateau DEL 1
HOTSPOT 0, 0, 0 HOTSPOT A, 0, 0 HOTSPOT 0, B, 0 HOTSPOT A, B, 0 HOTSPOT 0, 0, hauteurTable HOTSPOT A, 0, hauteurTable HOTSPOT 0, B, hauteurTable HOTSPOT A, B, hauteurTable
Symbol.Script_2D:
! ===== SCRIPT 2D ===== PEN stylo
HOTSPOT2 0, 0 HOTSPOT2 A, 0 HOTSPOT2 0, B HOTSPOT2 A, B HOTSPOT2 A/2, B/2
RECT2 0, 0, A, B
LINE_TYPE 2 FOR i = 1 TO 4 RECT2 px[i], py[i], px[i] + largPied, py[i] + largPied NEXT i
Symbol.Script_VL: ! ===== SCRIPT PARAMETRES ===== VALUES "A" RANGE [0.40, 4.00] VALUES "B" RANGE [0.30, 2.00] VALUES "hauteurTable" RANGE [0.30, 1.20] VALUES "epPlateau" RANGE [0.01, 0.10] VALUES "largPied" RANGE [0.02, 0.15] VALUES "retraitPied" RANGE [0.00, 0.50]
